name: Tsukubane Shinobu
source:
"Y-You mustn't ask such things! Goodness, Rin-chan, you're a pervert."

Likes: Theatre-going, her little brothers
Talents: Doing any kind of housework quickly, lulling others to sleep
Dislikes: Saying selfish things
Favorite times of year: April with its breezes, May with its sunlight filtering through the trees

A gentle and kind-hearted classmate. The daughter of a Kobe trader, she is a "high-collar" girl with a very open-minded sensibility. Her mere touch can soothe anyone, though she also has a bit of a childish side.

She will look after Rin to the best of her ability, sheepishly admitting that he reminds her of her little brothers.

She is kind to Japanese and foreign students alike, and always manages to keep a middle ground between Rin and Chris, who tend to clash with each other.
